Introduction

Wooyoung is a South Korean dancer, singer, and songwriter under KQ Entertainment. He is a member of the boy group ATEEZ, whom he debuted on October 24, 2018 with the release of their first mini album "TREASURE EP.1: All to Zero".

Before debuting, Wooyoung appeared and competed on the survival show "MIXNINE" where he was eliminated after ranking 132nd.

On May 8, 2023, KQ Entertainment announced that Wooyoung will be going on a temporary hiatus due to an ankle injury. On May 29, the hiatus ended.
